summary: Lobby: static HTML/CSS shell plus app.js that builds room cards from __benchHost.params.rooms (ko/en titles; coming-soon cards are not links) and swaps hero/sections for #/room/<id> with the lobby DOM kept alive. Decisions: default language is always ko (Playwright's locale is en-US, so navigator.language is ignored; the toggle persists); system font stacks only (no OFL font vendored); no CSS radial gradients (+-1px raster noise risked G-determinism), hero art is vector. Unverified here: G-live FLIP (bench python path breaks in this layout), tests.hidden (public tests not wired).
